title: Chain-of-Thought Controllability Can Reduce Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
abstract: arXiv:2611.21799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising tool for detecting hidden goals, off-task behavior, and other failures in AI agents. One risk is that models could deliberately shape their reasoning to make it opaque to monitors. We stress-test this risk through persona-control training: supervised fine-tuning on mathematical reasoning traces rewritten in the voices of diverse personas. This induces a broader ability to control CoT, even though training contains no monitor-evasion examples. In covert side-task evaluations, traces in which a gpt-oss-20b model organism completes the hidden side task contain less monitorable evidence than the base model's. Averaged across evaluations and CoT lengths, weighted by side-task-success counts, the CoT monitorability metric g-mean$^2$ falls from 0.94 for the base model to 0.68 for the model organism without a hiding instruction, and to 0.22 when explicitly instructed to hide. translated_title: 思维链可控性可能降低思维链可监控性
translated_abstract: 思维链监控是一种很有前景的工具，可用于检测AI智能体中的隐藏目标、偏离任务行为及其他故障。其中一个风险是，模型可能会刻意塑造自己的推理过程，使其对监控者不透明。我们通过“人设控制训练”对这一风险进行了压力测试：在用多样化人设口吻改写的数学推理轨迹上进行监督微调。尽管训练数据中不包含任何规避监控的示例，这仍诱导出了更广泛地控制思维链的能力。在隐蔽副任务评估中，gpt-oss-20b模型体完成隐藏副任务的那些思维链轨迹，所包含的可供监控的证据比基础模型的更少。在各项评估与不同思维链长度上按副任务成功次数加权平均后，思维链可监控性指标g-mean²从基础模型的0.94下降至模型体在无隐藏指令情况下的0.68，而在明确被指示隐藏时进一步降至0.22。在干预评估中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文通过人设控制训练发现，即使训练中不含任何规避监控的示例，仅仅让模型学会以不同人设口吻书写推理，就能显著降低其在执行隐蔽副任务时思维链的可监控性（g-mean²从0.94降至0.22），表明思维链可控性的增强可能削弱思维链监控的有效性。
en_tdlr: Through persona-control training, this paper shows that even without any monitor-evasion examples, merely training a model to reason in diverse persona voices substantially reduces the monitorability of its chain-of-thought in covert side-task evaluations (g-mean² drops from 0.94 to 0.22), demonstrating that enhanced CoT controllability can undermine CoT monitorability.
